# ==========================================
# SECTION 2: BUSINESS DESCRIPTION
# ==========================================

Business-Description-Short: SecureDApp is a blockchain security audit and compliance platform specializing in smart contract audits, DPDP compliance (India), and Web3 security. Trusted by 100+ projects with 2,400+ vulnerabilities detected.

Business-Description-Long: SecureDApp (Vettedcode Technologies India Pvt. Ltd.) is India's leading blockchain security and compliance platform. It combines advanced smart contract auditing, threat intelligence, and regulatory compliance solutions to protect the Web3 ecosystem. The platform specializes in smart contract security audits, DPDP compliance (critical for India's Data Protection Act), RBI cryptocurrency guidelines, AML-KYC compliance, and blockchain forensics. With 100+ audited projects and $600M+ in protected assets, SecureDApp is the trusted security partner for DeFi protocols, enterprise blockchain solutions, and token projects.

Value-Proposition: "Securing the Web3 Ecosystem. Trusted by 100+ projects. 2,400+ vulnerabilities detected. $600M+ assets protected."

Core-Mission: Protect the blockchain ecosystem through advanced security audits, compliance frameworks, and threat intelligence while ensuring regulatory adherence in emerging Web3 markets.

Target-Audience:
  - Blockchain Projects (DeFi, NFT, Layer 2)
  - Token Projects (ERC-20, ERC-721, Custom tokens)
  - DApp Developers
  - Smart Contract Engineers
  - Cryptocurrency Exchanges
  - Fintech Companies
  - Enterprise Blockchain Users
  - Startups (Pre-launch security)

Enterprise-Target-Audience:
  - Banks & Financial Institutions
  - Investment Firms
  - Regulatory Bodies
  - Compliance Officers
